copy.tagline: 自动验证数据质量,提前发现数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据管道,需要自动检查数据质量,避免坏数据流入下游。
copy.tagline_en: Catch data issues early with automated quality checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run data pipelines and want automated quality checks to catch issues early.

howto.what: Claude 会按你的表结构写数据质量校验：为核心列生成 Great Expectations 期望规则、dbt 测试和数据契约，并汇总每张表通过/失败的校验报告。
howto.when: 当你要搭建数据质量管道、实现校验规则或建立团队之间的数据契约时接管。

say.text: 给 orders 表的 order_id 加非空和唯一校验
say.note: 生成对应的 Great Expectations 规则

say.text: 帮我为 orders 和 customers 表建一份数据契约
say.note: 输出带版本的数据契约文件

say.text: 跑一次全表校验，有失败就报错中断
say.note: 生成每张表的通过/失败报告并抛异常

howto.what_en: Claude writes data quality validation for your tables: Great Expectations rules for key columns, dbt tests, and data contracts, plus a pass/fail report per table.
howto.when_en: Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts between teams.

say_en.text: Add not-null and unique checks to order_id in the orders table
say_en.note: Generates the matching Great Expectations rules

say_en.text: Create a data contract between the orders and customers tables
say_en.note: Outputs a versioned data contract file

say_en.text: Run validation on all tables and fail the pipeline on errors
say_en.note: Builds per-table reports and raises an error
